segments.say: Anthropic just dropped a prompting guide for Opus 5.5,
which is the newest and most powerful model.
Three things in it are going to flip how you use it, especially the last one.
Number one, stop telling it to think carefully.
Opus 5.5 already decides how much to think on its own.
Number two, start on medium effort.
Effort is basically the setting that controls how hard Claude thinks before it answers,
and medium on Opus 5.5 is the sweet spot with performance and speed.
Number three, tell it what done looks like.
Give it everything you want to accomplish and what the final outcome slash goal looks like.
This will help get a polished result much faster.
